sources.name: Joshua Project Data API
sources.publicRedistribution: value-added use only; full static database scale requires written confirmation before release
requirements: non-commercial use
clear linked attribution on pages displaying Joshua Project content
do not directly replicate Joshua Project services or presentation
keep API credentials out of client code and repository
treat data as estimates rather than perfectly precise facts
support removal of cached/generated data if API access is terminated
sources.permissionGate: Written confirmation required before a public build exposes a substantial portion of the Joshua Project database through static browser-accessible files.

sources.name: Joshua Project People-Group Photos
requirements: verify the rights of each individual image
do not scrape or mirror the Joshua Project photo library

sources.name: PeopleGroups.org Public API
sources.provider: International Mission Board Global Research Department
sources.publicRedistribution: public read-only API use in maps, prayer tools and research applications is explicitly invited; bulk/static redistribution terms are not yet explicit enough for a bundled mirror
sources.cacheStatus: development ingestion allowed; public bulk caching/mirroring remains gated pending an explicit redistribution review
sources.attributionText: Data provided and maintained by the Global Research Department of the International Mission Board via PeopleGroups.org
requirements: treat the API as beta and tolerate schema or availability changes
preserve IMB GSEC, SPI and LPI semantics instead of mapping them to Joshua Project JPScale or Frontier fields
do not infer exact evangelical percentages from categorical evangelical-level labels
do not convert generic Bible availability into translation-completeness status without a documented mapping
do not bundle or mirror the complete dataset until static redistribution and caching terms are confirmed
do not reuse linked third-party photos unless each photo's rights are separately verified
sources.permissionGate: Before any static browser bundle or durable public mirror is enabled, confirm redistribution and caching terms. Direct live API use requires a separate runtime, CORS, reliability and privacy review before production activation.

sources.name: Natural Earth
requirements: document any deliberate boundary modifications
retain awareness of disputed-boundary representation

sources.name: ProgressBible Registered User Data
sources.publicRedistribution: not approved for product inclusion without written permission
requirements: do not ingest registered supplied data into Unreached without written permission
do not scrape the public website into a replacement dataset
sources.permissionGate: Written permission explicitly covering inclusion in this public browser product is required.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.provider: individual media rights holders / Wikimedia Commons
requirements: verify the individual file license
record creator, source, license, license URL, attribution and modification status
satisfy ShareAlike obligations where applicable
consider personality and privacy rights independently of copyright

sources.name: Ethnologue
requirements: do not scrape or bulk reproduce proprietary linguistic data
obtain a compatible license before dataset integration
sources.permissionGate: Obtain a compatible license before any Ethnologue-derived dataset is integrated into this public product.
